article_title: Pig kidney works in human body for 271 days - is this the future of organ transplants?

tasks.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: A proposal to replace every human transplant with dialysis
A record pig-kidney transplant that acted as a temporary bridge while showing both promise and unresolved challenges
A new farming method for ordinary pigs
The first successful permanent cure for diabetes
tasks.correct_answer: A record pig-kidney transplant that acted as a temporary bridge while showing both promise and unresolved challenges
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה עוסקת בכליית חזיר מהונדסת שפעלה 271 ימים כפתרון זמני עד להשתלה אנושית, לצד הקשיים שנותרו.

tasks.prompt: How long did the transplanted pig kidney function in Tim Andrews' body?
options: 82 days
Five years
271 days
Seven years
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכליה פעלה 271 ימים—משך הזמן הארוך ביותר שתועד להשתלה מסוג זה.

tasks.prompt: What happened after the pig kidney was removed?
options: Andrews needed dialysis for 82 days before receiving a human donor kidney
He immediately received another pig kidney
He no longer needed any kidney treatment
He remained on dialysis for seven years
tasks.correct_answer: Andrews needed dialysis for 82 days before receiving a human donor kidney
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לאחר הוצאת כליית החזיר אנדרוז עבר דיאליזה במשך 82 ימים, עד שקיבל כליה מתורם אנושי.

tasks.prompt: Why do doctors describe pig organs as a possible “bridge”?
options: They permanently eliminate the need for human donors
They are used only to test hospital machines
They can temporarily keep a patient off dialysis while waiting for a human organ
They prevent all immune reactions without medication
tasks.correct_answer: They can temporarily keep a patient off dialysis while waiting for a human organ
tasks.explanation_hebrew: bridge הוא פתרון ביניים: האיבר מן החזיר עשוי לתפקד עד שתימצא כליה אנושית מתאימה.

tasks.prompt: What does “xenotransplantation” mean in the article?
options: Using an organ or tissue from another species in a transplant
Filtering blood through a dialysis machine
Transplanting only between identical twins
Editing a patient's own human kidney
tasks.correct_answer: Using an organ or tissue from another species in a transplant
tasks.explanation_hebrew: xenotransplantation היא השתלה בין מינים—כאן שימוש בכליה מחזיר עבור אדם.

tasks.prompt: What does “camouflage netting” describe in the explanation of the genetic changes?
options: A physical net placed around the kidney
Human DNA added to help conceal pig tissue from the immune system
A method for transporting pigs to hospital
A scan that detects blood-vessel damage
tasks.correct_answer: Human DNA added to help conceal pig tissue from the immune system
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הדימוי מתאר DNA אנושי שנוסף כדי להסוות את רקמת החזיר ולהקטין את זיהויה בידי מערכת החיסון.

tasks.prompt: Explain why the donor pig was genetically modified and describe the types of changes made.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר את סכנת הדחייה ולציין את שלושת סוגי השינויים המתוארים.
expected_points: An unmodified pig organ would be recognised as foreign
The immune system could rapidly attack and destroy it
The Yucatan miniature pigs received 69 genomic modifications
Some pig-cell features recognised by the immune system were removed
Human DNA was added to help hide the tissue
Viruses embedded in pig DNA were disabled to reduce infection risk

tasks.prompt: What does Andrews' case reveal about both the promise and the limitations of xenotransplantation?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג לפחות שתי תועלות ולפחות שני אתגרים מתוך הכתבה.
expected_points: The kidney worked immediately
It functioned for a record 271 days
It spared Andrews months of dialysis
It allowed time for a human donor to be found
Early rejection signs were controlled by medication
Blood vessels later became damaged and the organ inflamed
The organ ultimately failed and had to be removed
Doctors still do not know exactly why it failed

tasks.prompt: Summarise Andrews' medical journey and the wider reason doctors are studying pig kidneys.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול את המחלה, המחסור באיברים, ההשתלה, הכשל והמעבר לכליה אנושית.
expected_points: Andrews had end-stage kidney disease caused by type 2 diabetes
He faced a potentially seven-year wait for a kidney
Organ shortages leave about 100,000 Americans waiting
He received a genetically modified pig kidney in January 2025
The kidney worked for 271 days
It was removed after damage and inflammation
He returned to dialysis for 82 days
He received a human donor kidney in January 2026
Doctors see xenotransplantation as a possible alternative or bridge

tasks.prompt: Write a balanced explanation for patients of what this case does and does not prove about pig-kidney transplants.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכתוב באנגלית ברגישות ובדיוק, לכלול נתונים מרכזיים ולא להציג את הטיפול כפתרון מוכח וקבוע.
expected_points: State that this was a record 271-day case
Explain the bridge-to-human-transplant idea
Mention the genetically modified donor pig
Describe the period without dialysis
Explain that the kidney eventually failed
Mention unresolved blood-vessel damage and inflammation
Note that one case cannot establish routine long-term success
Connect the research to the shortage of donor organs
